newsitem.title: FRANCE: BNP gains ground in catch-up move.
newsitem.headline: BNP gains ground in catch-up move.

text.p: French bank BNP was up more than three percent in late trade, catching up on gains made by the rest of the sector, dealers said.
At 1558 GMT, the bank was 3.38 percent higher at 245.0 francs with 850,034 shares traded, surpassing its 1993 flotation price of 240 francs for the first time since July 1995.
It has clawed its way back from a low of 171.50 last August. Since the start of the year it has gained more than 22 percent.
"The climb observed over the last few weeks is just basically catchup," said one analyst. Another analyst said BNP "was most behind the others in gaining ground."
